name: es30-srgb
title: sRGB textures and sRGB render targets
summary: SRGB8 and SRGB8_ALPHA8 textures decode to linear on sampling (equation 3.26, alpha unchanged, filtering order allowed either way); SRGB8_ALPHA8 render targets encode on write (equation 4.1) and blend in linear space; clears and glBlitFramebuffer follow the same conversions; FRAMEBUFFER_ATTACHMENT_COLOR_ENCODING reports SRGB or LINEAR (also for the default framebuffer); glCopyTexImage2D refuses to mix the encodings. A gamma-ramp picture of eight bands compares linear and sRGB handling; values are read back bit for bit through an RGBA32UI target and as stored bytes.
spec: ES 3.0 §3.8.16 sRGB Texture Color Conversion (equation 3.26; alpha unchanged; conversion before or after filtering), Table 3.13 (SRGB8 texture-only, SRGB8_ALPHA8 renderable)
ES 3.0 §4.1.7.1 Blend Equation (destination linearized before blending when COLOR_ENCODING is SRGB), §4.1.8 sRGB Conversion (equation 4.1), §2.1.1 Floating-Point Computation

ES 3.0 §4.2.3 Clearing the Buffers (Clear and ClearBuffer apply sRGB conversion), §4.3.3 Copying Pixels (BlitFramebuffer decodes an SRGB read buffer and encodes into an SRGB draw buffer), §4.3.2 Reading Pixels (stored values are returned)

ES 3.0 §3.8.5 Alternate Texture Image Specification Commands (CopyTexImage2D: sRGB/linear mismatch is INVALID_OPERATION), §4.4.2.1 Renderbuffer Objects (ES 3.2 §9.2.4 states INVALID_ENUM for a non-renderable internalformat), §4.4.4.1 / §4.4.4.2 (attachment completeness needs a color-renderable format)

ES 3.0 §6.1.13 Framebuffer Object Queries (FRAMEBUFFER_ATTACHMENT_COLOR_ENCODING: LINEAR or SRGB; default framebuffer implementation-defined; attachment BACK), §2.1.6 Fixed-Point Data Conversions (equations 2.1, 2.3), §4.1.9 Dithering
GLSL ES 3.00 §8.8 Texture Lookup Functions (texture, texelFetch), §8.3 floatBitsToUint

api.glGenTextures: RGBA8, SRGB8_ALPHA8, SRGB8 ramps, the two-texel filtering texture, the stored-bytes view and the two 256 x 2 render-target textures
api.glBindTexture: textures on unit 0 for the exact path and the bands
api.glTexImage2D: SRGB8_ALPHA8 and SRGB8 uploads (RGBA and RGB with UNSIGNED_BYTE): sampled values are decoded (equation 3.26, alpha unchanged / 1) in an exact RGBA32UI readback and in the bands; RGBA8 control; SRGB8_ALPHA8 / RGBA8 render-target textures
api.glTexSubImage2D: the stored bytes read back from the render targets are uploaded to an RGBA8 texture and shown raw in bands 3 to 5, and compared with the window
api.glTexParameteri: NEAREST filters of the ramps, LINEAR filters and CLAMP_TO_EDGE of the two-texel texture (typed glTexParameter overloads): the filtered result is the average of the decoded texels
api.glGenRenderbuffers: SRGB8_ALPHA8, RGBA8, RGBA32UI and DEPTH_COMPONENT16 renderbuffers
api.glRenderbufferStorage: SRGB8_ALPHA8 storage accepted and used as a render target (clears, blits, encoding queries); SRGB8 storage -> INVALID_ENUM (not color-renderable)
api.glGenFramebuffers: framebuffers with sRGB / linear texture and renderbuffer targets, plus one for the incompleteness case
api.glBindFramebuffer: FRAMEBUFFER, READ_FRAMEBUFFER and DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER targets for rendering, reading, blitting and querying
api.glFramebufferTexture2D: SRGB8_ALPHA8 and RGBA8 textures as COLOR_ATTACHMENT0: complete; an SRGB8 texture -> FRAMEBUFFER_INCOMPLETE_ATTACHMENT
api.glFramebufferRenderbuffer: SRGB8_ALPHA8, RGBA8, RGBA32UI color renderbuffers and a depth renderbuffer; encodings queried
api.glCheckFramebufferStatus: FRAMEBUFFER_COMPLETE for the targets, FRAMEBUFFER_INCOMPLETE_ATTACHMENT for an SRGB8 texture attachment
api.glGetFramebufferAttachmentParameteriv: FRAMEBUFFER_ATTACHMENT_COLOR_ENCODING: SRGB for SRGB8_ALPHA8 texture and renderbuffer, LINEAR for RGBA8 texture and renderbuffer, RGBA32UI and a depth attachment, LINEAR or SRGB for the default framebuffer's BACK buffer (DefaultFramebufferQueryAttachment overload), which decides what a window write stores
api.glReadPixels: RGBA/UNSIGNED_BYTE stored bytes of the SRGB8_ALPHA8 and RGBA8 targets compared with equation 4.1 / the blend model; RGBA_INTEGER/UNSIGNED_INT words of the exact decode path; window bands and patch
api.glClear: COLOR_BUFFER_BIT on an SRGB8_ALPHA8 renderbuffer stores the encoded clear color; on RGBA8 as is
api.glClearColor: clear color (0.4, 0.2, 0.8, 0.6) read back encoded (sRGB target) or as is (RGBA8)
api.glClearBufferfv: COLOR on an SRGB8_ALPHA8 renderbuffer stores the same encoded color
api.glBlitFramebuffer: SRGB8_ALPHA8 -> RGBA8 arrives decoded, RGBA8 -> SRGB8_ALPHA8 arrives encoded, SRGB8_ALPHA8 -> SRGB8_ALPHA8 unchanged (all 256 x 4 bytes)
api.glCopyTexImage2D: INVALID_OPERATION for a LINEAR read buffer into SRGB8_ALPHA8 and for an SRGB read buffer into RGBA8; the matching pairs are accepted
api.glEnable: BLEND on the SRGB8_ALPHA8 and RGBA8 targets: the stored bytes follow the linear-space versus stored-value blend models
api.glDisable: BLEND restored between draws (the next draws are not blended)
api.glBlendFunc: SRC_ALPHA, ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA with a (1, 1, 1, 0.5) overlay: result = 0.5 + 0.5 * (linearized) destination, in all 768 color bytes of both targets
api.glUseProgram: ramp, overlay/patch color, exact-decode and band programs
api.glGetUniformLocation: u_tex, u_mode, u_uv, u_row, u_channel, u_encode, u_color located
api.glUniform1i: u_tex unit, u_mode, u_row, u_channel, u_encode: the bands show the intended rows and channels
api.glUniform2f: u_uv = (0.5, 0.5): the lookup lands exactly between the two texels of the filtering texture
api.glUniform4f: u_color: the (1, 1, 1, 0.5) overlay and the window patch are stored as predicted
api.glDrawArrays: TRIANGLE_STRIP quads from gl_VertexID for ramps, overlay, bands and the exact path
api.glViewport: 256 x 2 / 256 x 1 target viewports (overlay in row 1 only) and the 32-pixel band viewports

visual_review.notes: 256x256 radeonsi es-max capture viewed at 3x (llvmpipe and zink captures differ by at most 1/255 per channel). Eight full-width gray bands, band 0 on top. Band 0 is the straight 0..255 ramp; band 1 the dark decoded curve (value 55 at the middle column); band 2 the straight ramp again (decode then shader encode); band 3 a bright curve that rises steeply over the first few columns (encode on write, 188 in the middle); band 4 starts near 0.8 gray and ends white (50% white blended in linear space, 225 in the middle); band 5 a straight line from mid gray to white (the same overlay blended in stored values, 191 in the middle); band 6 the straight alpha ramp; band 7 the same dark curve as band 1. The window's bottom-left corner is black again after the default-framebuffer test patch was drawn and restored.
